svg.title: The cochlea uncoiled into a tube from its base (next to the stapes on the oval window) to its apex, with seven positions: high frequencies respond near the base and low frequencies near the apex. Below it, the primary auditory cortex has bands from 16,000 Hz down to 500 Hz, with the base of the cochlea mapping to the 16,000 Hz end and the apex to the 500 Hz end.
